title: Myths to correct
objectives: Correct seven debt myths with the reality behind each.
Explain why “higher yield means better fund” is the most expensive myth.
body_md:
“Debt funds are like FDs.” Reality: debt fund NAVs move daily and returns are not fixed or guaranteed. “Debt is risk-free.” Reality: debt has interest-rate, credit and liquidity risk; only the mix differs from equity. “Higher yield means a better fund.” Reality: higher yield usually means lower credit quality or longer duration — ask why it is higher. “A AAA rating means it can't fail.” Reality: ratings are opinions that can change, sometimes quickly — diversify across issuers. “Government bonds can't lose money.” Reality: no default risk, but they can fall in price when rates rise, if sold before maturity. “My debt fund fell, so I should exit.” Reality: a rate-driven dip usually recovers as the fund earns its yield; a credit event needs a different decision — find out which it is. “FD interest is all real return.” Reality: after tax and inflation, an FD's real return can be close to zero.

| Myth | Reality |
| --- | --- |
| "Debt funds are like FDs." | Debt fund NAVs move daily and returns are not fixed or guaranteed. |
| "Debt is risk-free." | Debt has interest-rate, credit and liquidity risk; only the mix differs from equity. |
| "Higher yield means a better fund." | Higher yield usually means lower credit quality or longer duration. Ask why it is higher. |
| "A AAA rating means it can't fail." | Ratings are opinions that can change, sometimes quickly. Diversify across issuers. |
| "Government bonds can't lose money." | They have no default risk but can fall in price when rates rise, if sold before maturity. |
| "My debt fund fell, so I should exit." | A rate-driven dip usually recovers as the fund earns its yield; a credit event needs a different decision. Find out which it is. |
| "FD interest is all real return." | After tax and inflation, an FD's real return can be close to zero. |
example: FD at 7% with 6% inflation is about 1% real, before tax — “safe” money can still lose purchasing power.
say: Higher yield usually means lower credit quality or longer duration. Ask why.
A rate-driven dip usually recovers as the fund earns its yield; a credit event is different.
never: A AAA rating means a bond can't fail.

check.q: A client says “higher yield means a better fund”. What is the reality?
o: Higher yield usually means lower credit quality or longer duration
Only AAA funds show high yield
check.why: Higher yield usually means lower credit quality or longer duration. Ask why it is higher.

check.q: A client's debt fund fell. What should you establish first?
o: Whether it is a rate-driven dip or a credit event
check.why: A rate-driven dip usually recovers as the fund earns its yield; a credit event needs a different decision. Find out which it is.

check.q: “Government bonds can't lose money” is wrong because:
o: They can fall in price when rates rise, if sold before maturity
check.why: They have no default risk but can fall in price when rates rise, if sold before maturity.
